name: Fireside
summary: A crackling campfire in a pine clearing: hold to toast a marshmallow and let go when it is golden
about: A campfire burns in a ring of stones under the stars, with a little tent, swaying pines and sparks drifting into the night. Hold to lower a marshmallow into the flames and watch a meter as it turns from pale to golden to burnt: let go in the gold zone for a perfect toast and a burst of stars, or hold too long and it catches fire. Good for a camping or travel site, a cosy winter page or a playful game intro.
how: Press and hold Hold to toast (or hold anywhere on the scene, or hold Space) to lower the marshmallow into the fire.
Watch the toast meter and let go inside the gold zone; a perfect one puffs up with a shower of stars, then gets eaten in two bites.
Hold too long and it catches fire: it gets flicked into the flames and a fresh one slides onto the stick.
Add a log to make the fire roar up, tap the fire to poke it for sparks, and move your pointer to blow the flames about.
With reduced motion the stick glides without bounce and there are far fewer sparks.
